svg.title: Napoli Walks — COURSE PROJECT
svg.desc: Free walking tours in Naples: tours, bookings, reports. Exam project for Introduction to Web Applications: guides publish tours, participants reserve places, and guides file post-tour reports. Server-rendered Flask with SQLite. Built with Python, Flask, Flask-Login, SQLite, Jinja.
svg.text: Free walking tours in Naples: tours, bookings, reports.
